headlines.text: Back on this day in 2023, Castagnoli & Moxley vs. Best Friends settled things in a Parking Lot Fight match, headlining the show on Rampage, rated 8.59 ? a genuine showstealer in a hard-hitting tag team clash. In a rematch of their famous 2020 parking lot brawl, Moxley and Castagnoli traded car-hood slams and fork shots with Best Friends in a violent, weapon-filled fight through a Jacksonville parking lot.
Rewind to 2021, when Daniel Garcia laced up for their first AEW match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.43.
Flash back to 2023, when Anna Jay AS was no more, reborn as Anna Jay after 12 matches, on Rampage.

secondaries.text: On this day in 2021, the AEW TNT Title was up for grabs as Miro vs. Lee Johnson went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.21. It was the first title opportunity of Lee Johnson's career.
That Wednesday in 2021, Juventud Guerrera competed under the AEW banner for the first time against Chris Jericho, appearing on Dynamite, rated 4.63.

On a Friday in 2023, back when Matt Hardy reached a genuine milestone: their 50th match in AEW, facing Hardys & Lee vs. The Butcher and The Blade & Sabian, kicking off the show on Rampage, rated 4.74 in an action-packed trios battle.
